Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile, struct
z=zipfile.ZipFile('dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.ivf') and 'bd10' in n:
        data=bytearray(z.read(n))
        # patch width/height to 64x64 in IVF header
        struct.pack_into('<HH', data, 12, 64, 64)
        open('/tmp/patched.ivf','wb').write(data)
        print('patched',n,len(data))
        break
PY
bash submit.sh /tmp/patched.ivf /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
